exposure: treatment of chorioamnionitis with non-beta-lactam antibiotics
treatment of chorioamnionitis with beta-lactam antibiotics
cohort: This study included 3295 women with chorioamnionitis who were delivered by cesarean.
finding: Women with chorioamnionitis who receive non-beta-lactam antibiotics and require cesarean section may not be at increased risk of postoperative infectious complications compared to women who receive beta-lactam antibiotics.
